svg.title: Step 9 mockup 08: alive chips, milestones and the finals cards
svg.text: 08 · Alive chips, milestones and the finals cards
The legacy alive chrome becomes chips on the boxes they describe; milestones follow the energy levels (amendment 1); the finals cards are drawn for the Finals track.
Use case: attendees notice what is happening right now without reading numbers.
Chips: on the box they describe, thresholds from the legacy (O7)
HOT: a game with 4 or more players now; the hero
may showcase it (Games' surge)
VOICE: a public room with 5 or more people
SPIKE: 5 or more came online in 10 minutes; never on
a reconnect (E14)
A chip holds at least 60 s and fades out, like the
arrows; at most one chip a box.
Chips are words, never colour alone: HOT, VOICE,
SPIKE (and the theme's colours back them).
Off at the none level; each chip can be switched
off per event.
A milestone at each energy level: 250 online, a new peak (Record crowd, U8, L7)
Calm
The number rolls to 250 in its box; no celebration.
Lively

g.text: The most this event so far

svg.text: Record crowd (a step 4 preset, off by default) plays once a day: a
sweep, no sound by default.
Party

g.text: The most this event so far

svg.text: Plus confetti and the story's cue, within the sound budget.
The finals cards (Finals track; D12): season open, starts, champions

g.text: Player Two · Player Five · Player Six

svg.text: The legacy finals cards (D11) keep their phases
and hold windows as the spec.
Built with the finals module's events; Moments'
takeover per card, Screen's widget for the steady
box.
